submitted.rationale: The illumination is 2.06 eV. That is below the band gap of BiVO4 (about 2.4 eV), so the photocurrent should come from the lower-gap copper-vanadate phase (Cu:V near 3:2). Photocurrent went up as the Bi fraction went down: index 13 (Bi 0.27) gave 0; index 100 (Bi 0.076) gave 3e-8 A; index 66 (Bi 0.039, Cu 0.58, V 0.38) gave 6e-8 A. Index 66 is the best of the three.

rejected.reason: Mid-Bi composition (Bi 0.27) gave zero photocurrent at 2.06 eV.
Its photocurrent (3e-8 A) was half that of index 66, which has less Bi.
The GP suggestion had a mean near 1e-8 A, with an uncertainty larger than the mean after only 2 points. Measuring the lower-Bi copper-vanadate composition was the better use of the last measurement.
